title: Textbook rules: FP8 GEMM shapes and torchao's compile dependence
summary: two rules from the training-infrastructure handbook survey (2026-10-23) and the harvests, checked against the store (FABLE_DESIGN_CHECK section 6): data for the proposer, no constraint

text: FP8 GEMMs need the K and N dimensions of every Linear to be multiples of 16 (MXFP8: 32) after tensor parallelism splits them (hidden / tp, ffn / tp, the attention projections, vocab / tp): check target.model and the layout before proposing FP8; a layer with other dimensions stays in bf16 or the run fails.

torchao float8 (Float8Linear) is slower than bf16 without torch.compile (its casts and scalings run as separate kernels): propose it together with compile. Transformer Engine FP8 (Megatron) does not depend on compile. Harvest rules h20-R2 and h20w2-R38 measured both.
